description: Materializable asset that transitions an MLflow model version between stages (e.g. Staging → Production). Auditable ML CD step in the Dagster asset graph.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per selected item discovered in the vendor. See README for what each materialization produces.

tracking_uri_env_var.label: Tracking Uri Env Var
tracking_uri_env_var.description: Env var holding the MLflow Tracking URI.

target_stage.label: Target Stage
target_stage.description: Stage to promote to (Production / Staging / Archived / None).

source_stage.label: Source Stage
source_stage.description: If set, promote the LATEST version at this stage. Mutually exclusive with `model_version`.

model_version.label: Model Version
model_version.description: If set, promote this specific version. Mutually exclusive with `source_stage`.

archive_existing_target.label: Archive Existing Target
archive_existing_target.description: Whether to archive any existing model versions at `target_stage` before promoting the new one. Matches MLflow's `archive_existing_versions` flag.

description_prefix.label: Description Prefix
description_prefix.description: Prepended to the promotion's Dagster asset description.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Asset group name for the promotion asset.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Prefix for the asset key (list of strings for hierarchical keys).

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var for HTTP-basic MLflow auth username (optional).

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var for HTTP-basic MLflow auth password (optional).
